title: docs(plugin-dashboard,plugin-report,types): comments and docs stop describing the dashboard chartConfig axis / series merge spec 17.5.0 retired (objectui#11373)
body:
Fixes #11373

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Comments, one docs sentence and one pending changeset. No code changed: every changed line in the `.ts` / `.tsx` files is a comment line (116 comment lines, 0 other lines, counted from `git diff -U0` against the merge base `31987bd50`).

Each sentence that said something false at `main` now says what is true:

- `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 refuses `type` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` (and `aria`) on a dashboard widget's `chartConfig` (`DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema`). Measured on the installed spec: `safeParse` refuses each of the five and accepts `title`.
- The react `ObjectChart` tier keeps `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series`.
- `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation` no longer exist. objectui#11372 removed them (squash `f9c8c4e45`).
- objectstack#17385 has been in state `completed` since 2026-09-20, and the spec PR that ended it is the retirement. objectstack#5175 has been in state `not_planned` since 2026-08-10: it moved to objectui#4044, which is also done.

A sentence that is true history ("was re-exported here until objectui#11315") stays as written. Where a history sentence names the removed function, it now also says the function is gone.

## The sites, sentence by sentence

Population: `git grep -n -E 'mergeAuthoredPresentation|axisPresentation|objectstack#17385|objectstack#5175'` at `31987bd50` gives the seat's list exactly (21 hits, changelogs and the `11372` / `10132` / `11315` changesets included). A broader grep for `full ChartConfigSchema`, `chartConfig.series|xAxis|yAxis` and `authored axis|axes|series` turned up nothing beyond those sites. Its other hits are true or belong to another carrier: the list view's `chartConfig.xAxisField` in app-shell, and report and ObjectChart pins.

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`, `chartConfigPresentation` re-export docblock | "…see that module's header." / "…so this widget no longer calls it." | The admission criteria and the `aria` reason live in `chartConfigPresentation`'s docblock, not the module header, so the pointer names both. "…so this widget stopped calling it, and objectui#11372 then removed it from `@object-ui/core`." |
| `DatasetWidget.tsx`, "The chart's STRUCTURE is the dataset's" | "(#4229, through `@object-ui/core`'s `mergeAuthoredPresentation`)" | "(#4229, through `mergeAuthoredPresentation`, which objectui#11372 has since removed from `@object-ui/core`)" |
| `plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`, inline relay | "declared as the spec's full `ChartConfigSchema` on EVERY dashboard widget" and "keeps objectstack#17385's open precedence question … out of this change" | Declared on every widget, since 17.5.0 as `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema` (appearance keys, the four structure keys refused at parse). The whitelist emits no `xAxisKey` / `series`, and there is no authored axis to weigh against the derived bindings: 17.5.0 refuses them, which answered the question objectstack#17385 carried. |
| `__tests__/DashboardChart.chartConfig-4044.test.tsx`, header "What was measured" | "`chartConfig` is declared as the spec's full `ChartConfigSchema`" | "was declared … ; since spec 17.5.0 it is `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema`" |
| same header, "keys deliberately NOT here" | `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series`: "an open PROTOCOL question … objectstack#17385 … cannot pre-empt it"; `aria`: "declared by the spec" | 17.5.0 refuses all three at parse, which answered objectstack#17385: the derived binding wins. `type` is also refused at parse. `aria` is no longer declared: a `retiredKey` tombstone (objectstack#17751). |
| same file, refusal block (`emits no xAxis / yAxis / series from chartConfig`) | "objectstack#17385 owns the precedence … Until it answers, the three keys must not travel" | 17.5.0 refuses them and the derived binding wins. A widget that reaches the relay still carrying them (stored metadata never re-validated) must not have them travel. |
| `__tests__/DatasetWidget.chartConfig.dom.test.tsx`, the `aria` negative pin | "the current contract, pending objectstack#5175" | The protocol settled the same way: 17.5.0 retired `ChartConfig.aria` (objectstack#17751). The pin holds the renderer side for a widget that reaches it without that parse. |
| `__tests__/DatasetWidget.comboPresentation.test.tsx`, History | "through `@object-ui/core`'s `mergeAuthoredPresentation`. This file pinned that merge." | Same, plus "(since removed by objectui#11372)". |
| `plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, import comment | "`mergeAuthoredSeries` — not `mergeAuthoredPresentation` — because…" | The chrome and the per-series presentation. No axis is lowered, and none needs to be: a report's axes are bare name strings. |
| `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, `authoredSeriesLabel` docblock | "the same ruling the dashboard's `mergeAuthoredPresentation` makes for its own `chartConfig.series`" | "the same ruling `mergeAuthoredSeries` (`@object-ui/core`) makes over this same `chart.series`". Read in core: "The FIRST entry naming a measure wins". |
| `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, the series-merge call site | "`mergeAuthoredSeries` is the same merge the dashboard makes" and "Deliberately NOT `mergeAuthoredPresentation`: that entry point also reads…" | `mergeAuthoredSeries` merges by `series[].name`. The dashboard made the same merge until 17.5.0 (objectui#11315). There is no axis to lower on this surface. The object-axis lowering was deliberately not used here and objectui#11372 removed it. |
| `types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`, `ChartSchema` axis comment | "a dashboard's dataset-bound chart hands it this node's `xAxis` / `yAxis` straight from the widget's `chartConfig` (`DatasetWidget` → `mergeAuthoredPresentation`)" | The react `ObjectChart` tier, where the spec keeps both keys, hands `ChartRenderer` the author's own axes. A dashboard widget no longer does, because 17.5.0 refuses them there (objectui#11315). |
| `plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx` | "used to build its schema through … `mergeAuthoredPresentation` … removed by objectui#11372" | **Unchanged**: true history, written by objectui#11372 itself. |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`, Axis options (**published**) | "the `ChartAxis` a dashboard widget's `chartConfig` uses" | "`ChartAxis` — the same object the react `ObjectChart` tier (an `object-chart` node) takes for its own `xAxis` / `yAxis`". Measured: `ObjectChartSchema.xAxis` / `yAxis` in `objectql.zod.ts` take the same `stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartAxisSchema)` as `ChartSchema`. |
| `.changeset/dashboard-inline-chartconfig-4044.md` (**publishes verbatim**) | "declared as the spec's full `ChartConfigSchema`"; "Five of the fourteen declared keys"; `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` "an open protocol question … objectstack#17385"; `aria` "needs a reader … a separate decision" | "declared on every dashboard widget"; "Five of the fourteen keys of the spec's `ChartConfigSchema` are not forwarded, and 17.5.0 refuses all five on a dashboard widget's chart config at parse"; the three are refused by `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema`, which answered objectstack#17385; the spec retired `aria` instead of giving it a reader (objectstack#17751). The front matter is untouched. |

### The pending changeset: one PM assumption did not hold

The triage direction says this changeset's correction is "the one PR #11371 already made". **PR objectui#11371 did not touch this file.** Its file list (REST, 13 files) has no `dashboard-inline-chartconfig-4044.md`. Its own body lists the file under "Comments stale since 17.5.0 that this change does not touch". At `31987bd50`, the only commit in reach that touches the file is the shallow boundary.

The two false sentences (the open protocol question, and `aria` waiting on a separate decision) would have published in the same release as the `11315` changeset, which says the opposite. Following the ruling's intent ("re-read, not edit twice"), this PR edits the file once, and it is the only edit.

### Bounded edits beyond the listed sites

These are the same defect class, in files already on the claim's surface, comments only:

- the `aria` bullet in `DashboardChart.chartConfig-4044.test.tsx`'s header ("declared by the spec");
- the `aria` sentence in the pending changeset.

The spec's own CHANGELOG puts the `ChartConfig.aria` tombstone in the 17.5.0 section.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed:

- `plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.chartChrome.test.tsx` header calls `aria` "the one declared key with no reader anywhere on this path". It is no longer declared, since 17.5.0 retired it on `ReportChartSchema` too. This is the `aria` family, not this card's axis / series family, and the file is outside the claim. Carrier: none.
- `.changeset/11315-core-plugin-charts-no-release.md` says `mergeAuthoredPresentation` "keeps its signature and its behaviour". That was true of objectui#11371's own diff and became false with objectui#11372. The front matter is empty, so it publishes nothing. The dispatch excluded it. Carrier: none.
- The `aria` refusal test's own comment in `DashboardChart.chartConfig-4044.test.tsx` ("Delivering `aria` therefore needs a READER … Reported rather than guessed") was left as written. It records the measurement history of that card. The header bullet above now carries the retirement.
- Cross-file `path:line` citations elsewhere in `data-display.zod.ts` (the `data` comment) were not swept. They are outside the rewritten blocks, and the gate's ruling says not to sweep them. This diff adds none (gate verdict below).

## Verification

All runs are on head `f1a7fa00f`, the only commit on the branch.

- Tests, from the worktree root, through the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the three edited test files plus every `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` reader of `content/docs/**` and `.changeset/**` (17 files). Result: `Test Files  20 passed (20)` · `Tests  809 passed (809)` · lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:doc-fences`: ✅ exit 0.
- `pnpm check:doc-example-ids`: `✅ 415 real reference(s) all resolve`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`: `Links are valid across 17 scan roots.`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `✅ check-control-bytes: OK`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: exit 0. It is report-only and names 9 pending changesets that mention `data-display.zod.ts` / `DatasetWidget.tsx`. I read each one. None describes a comment this diff changed.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `✅ 7 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed … EMPTY frontmatter`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:doc-types`, `pnpm check:doc-example-readers`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `node scripts/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:doc-examples`: **NOT MEASURED**. Reason: `THE GATE COULD NOT RUN — the packages these examples import are not built`, which is a prerequisite, not a verdict. The `.mdx` change is prose outside every code fence, which is the only thing that gate type-checks. CI runs it after its build.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 7 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files:
  - Population, from `eslint.config.js`: rules are scoped to `**/*.{ts,tsx}` minus the `ignores` list. The `.md` / `.mdx` files are in no `files` glob.
  - Count, from `--format json`: 7 files, 0 errors, 32 warnings. Per file, base vs head through `--stdin` is identical for all 7.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` has 0 `projectService` / `parserOptions` / `TypeChecked` hits, so linting is not type-aware. No rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move the verdict of an untouched file.
  - With `--no-inline-config`, the run reports 1 error: `react-hooks/static-components` in `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`. It is the site carrying an `eslint-disable-next-line` that exists at the base too. The package `lint` script is `eslint .`, which honours the directive.
- Type-check: not run. No `.ts` / `.tsx` line outside a comment changed.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` reports `✅ NOT GOVERNED`.
